note: Concrete stat conversions at level 19. These explain why a stat is prioritized and back a future stat-weight tool. Verify per class at authoring time.

strength.label: Strength
strength.summary: Attack power for strength-based melee, plus a little block value.
conversions: 1 Strength = 2 attack power (Warrior, Paladin, Shaman, Druid Bear)

agility.label: Agility
agility.summary: Armor, crit, dodge, and attack power for agility classes.

stamina.label: Stamina
stamina.summary: Health - the stat the WSG meta prizes above all others; survivability wins games.
conversions: Stamina effectively beats every other primary stat in competitive play

intellect.label: Intellect
intellect.summary: Mana pool and spell crit for casters.

spirit.label: Spirit
spirit.summary: Mana regeneration and minor health regeneration.
conversions: Mana regen ~0.2-0.25 per Spirit every 5 seconds (class-dependent)

derived.name: Physical damage reduction
derived.notes: Uses the low-level armor constant (2015) - do not reuse the level-60 constant.

derived.name: Spell power scaling
derived.formula: A spell's 'up to X' scales by its coefficient (~0.35-1.0+)

notes: 1 Agility gives Hunters +1 melee and +2 ranged attack power, plus armor and crit.
Stamina still matters: survivability wins WSG even for a ranged class.
1 Agility gives Rogues +1 melee attack power, and Rogue dodge is ~0.26% per Agility - double the baseline.
Stamina to survive the burst trades that decide WSG fights.
The Protection flag-carrier build inverts the order - stamina first, to reach the ~1000+ health the meta targets.
1 Intellect = 15 mana, deepening the pool a healer leans on across a long flag game.
Stamina keeps the healer alive under focus - survivability still wins WSG.
Spirit adds between-cast mana regen; weighed behind stamina in competitive play.
